book.name: 1 THESALONIKA
book.title: THESALONIKA KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Uny sahlo, ma vytei hming a va cang nápaw a cai le a ning kong letah ca ciapah a hy bei he ceh.
Zecawtamaw tatah Abuipaw ning cawh zai tah, mehru hratah a vong a tahpaw khah a se pawtah naa hni thlang.
Cawngsaw tah, “Denah le a bingnah cai,” aa tah chung takhei sung sungkheh tah rorangnah cawh, canu ny a zeipaw hratah aa cung letah tlung a ka, ahohmai lua khy a bei he.
Canghrasala uny sahlo, naaning cawh muinah letah a ungpaw naa cang lynah cawtah ma ning cawh mehru hratah rawh ly pui tah va tlung a be.
Naaning cawh khainah sawtei le ching sawtei na cang he ceh. Kaaning cawh zai le muinah tei cang bei peh.
Macawtaco kaaning cawh a ihningpaw sahlo hrakhei cang kheh he peh seh. A hrahpaw le ma le pung a hraipaking khypaw cang hri he peh.
Zecawtamaw tatah a ihpaw sahlo cawh zai tah aa ih tei, zu a ruipaw zong zai tah aa rui tei.

Canghrasala kaaning cawh ningching cawngsaw kaa cang cawtah ma le pung a hraipaking khypaw ka cang he peh. Zingnah le donah khah cacanghnaw letah a pachawng tah pachahnah hnabeisuinah khah lukhu tah hmang he peh.
Zecawtamaw tatah Khazing tah a thingaenah ing pawtah a ma thingpaw cang lytah kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri thongtah pachahnah hmuh a pawtah a ma thingpaw a cang.
Kaa cawtah a thihnah rawng tah kaa thih zong tah cang seh, kaa hring zong tah cang seh, Ama khatah hmingkheh tah ka ung he peh.
Macawtaco pakheh le pakheh thawzaang a pei la, naa tua teipaw hrakhei a pasy leimei my lo.
Ahning cai biacawnah
Uny sahlo, naa hrong letei raitung a hrepaw sahlo le Abuipaw letei naa cung lang tei a ungpaw sahlo le a ca chinghring pawhe sahlo khah cizaw my lo.
Aa raihrepaw rawng takhei donah le cizawnah a sangpui tah pei my lo. Pakheh le pakheh a dorai teitah ung my lo.
Taico uny sahlo, a thawthipaw sahlo khah a raeringnah pei la, a raechiapaw sahlo khah thawzaang pei la, a thaw a diapaw sahlo khah bong la, ming vytei cung letah naa lungsy seh tatah kaa ca sia he.
Chahlynah khah chah ly ná tah verithing khe la, pakheh le pakheh cung letah cang seh, ming vytei cung letah cang seh, chahnah tua tukhah a zawng paria thlang my lo.
A lawng paria thlang my lo;
Thlawchang leimei thlang my lo;
Zezong kong ting letah alawngnah bia rei my lo. Khri Zisu letah ma heh naa cawtah Khazing dupaw cawh a cang.
Thlawpaw me khah thihsah khe lo;
Chinghlangnah bia khah zerei lytah ung khe lo.
Zezong pasepaning la, a chawpaw khah a lah my lo.
Chahlynah a cangpaw maikaw khah cahri my lo.

Denah Khazing, Ama Khazing hrahring taco naa pungpaluh tah ca pathaisah my he seh lo. Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a vong kaw tihtah a hme letah suise a kawh lypaw naa cang nápawtah naa thlawpaw le naa lungthing le naa pungsaw khah ca chia he seh.
Naaning a ca ypaw he cawh zingchuipaw cang ka, ma cawh Ama tah a tua a.
Uny sahlo, thlaw ma changpah my lo.
Uny vytei khah a hmuhpatang teitah naa kih a tle cy my lo.
Ma ca heh uny sahlo vytei reipah my lo, tatah Abuipaw hme letah bia ka ca caw he.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri ningdonah cawh naaning khatah ung seh.
